title: Pan-Seared Scallops with Ginger and Honey
description: Scallops are pan-seared to perfection with a sweet and savory ginger honey sauce, served with a side of steamed vegetables. This dish is a classic Chinese favorite, perfect for a quick and easy dinner.
instructions: 1. Rinse the scallops and pat them dry with paper towels.
2. In a small bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, ginger, and honey until well combined.
3. Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
4. Add the scallops to the skillet and sear for 2-3 minutes on each side, until golden brown.
5. Remove the scallops from the skillet and set them aside on a plate.
6. Add the chopped dates to the skillet and stir-fry for 1-2 minutes, until caramelized.
7. Pour the ginger honey sauce into the skillet and stir to combine.
8. Return the scallops to the skillet and toss them with the sauce until coated.
9. Serve the scallops hot, garnished with chopped green onions and a sprinkle of sesame seeds.
10. Serve with steamed vegetables on the side, if desired.
